mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS studentId, u.real_name AS studentName, u.username AS studentNo, c.name AS className, col.name AS collegeName, m.name AS majorName, w.id AS warningId, w.content AS reason, w.warning_type AS warningType, w.level AS levelCode, w.create_time AS createTime, w.status AS warningStatus, CASE WHEN w.level = 3 THEN 'high' WHEN w.level = 2 THEN 'medium' WHEN w.level = 1 THEN 'low' END AS level FROM warning_record w INNER JOIN sys_user u ON w.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN org_class c ON u.class_id = c.id LEFT JOIN org_major m ON c.major_id = m.id LEFT JOIN org_college col ON m.college_id = col.id WHERE w.id = #{id}

SELECT c.name AS courseName, ss.score, c.semester FROM student_score ss INNER JOIN course c ON ss.course_id = c.id WHERE ss.student_id = ( SELECT user_id FROM warning_record WHERE id = #{id} ) AND ss.status = 1 ORDER BY ss.create_time DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS totalSessions, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS attended, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS absent FROM attendance_record WHERE student_id = ( SELECT user_id FROM warning_record WHERE id = #{id} )

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN warning_type = 'absent' AND status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS absentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN warning_type = 'score' AND status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS failCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN warning_type = 'homework' AND status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS homeworkCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 3 AND status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS highLevelCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 2 AND status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS mediumLevelCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 1 AND status = 1 THEN 1 END) AS lowLevelCount FROM warning_record WHERE status = 1

SELECT w.id, w.title AS title, u.real_name AS studentName, u.username AS studentNo, c.name AS className, w.level, w.warning_type AS warningType, w.content AS reason, w.create_time AS createTime, w.status FROM warning_record w INNER JOIN sys_user u ON w.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN org_class c ON u.class_id = c.id WHERE w.status = 1
AND w.user_id = #{currentUserId}
AND w.level = 3 AND w.level = 2 AND w.level = 1
AND w.warning_type = #{dto.type}
AND u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.studentName}, '%')
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.studentNo}, '%')
ORDER BY w.level DESC, w.create_time DESC
